description: A stereo delay with four behaviours, a tone control in the feedback path and a modulation depth that does something different in each

params.text: Sets the delay time, one millisecond at the far left and 5 seconds at the far right
Sets how much of the output is fed back in, none at the far left and 0.95 at the far right
Sets the balance between the untouched input and the delayed signal
Tilts the tone of the repeats, dark at the far left and bright at the far right
Sets how much movement is added to the repeats: wow in repitch and ping-pong, tremolo in octave, and chorus in reverse
Cycles the four behaviours: repitch drags the pitch as the time changes, octave raises each repeat by an octave, reverse plays the repeats backwards, and ping-pong throws them side to side

notes: a Delay Expander placed immediately to the right adds tap tempo, a clock input and tempo-locked delay times
